description: This file is responsible for registering the root component of a React Native application using Expo. It imports the 'registerRootComponent' function from 'expo' and the main App component, then registers the App as the root component to bootstrap the application.

methods.name: registerRootComponent
methods.description: Registers the main App component as the root component for the React Native application, ensuring proper setup whether running in Expo Go or in a native build.
